The plan now has a "Missed more than once" section. It only reads your files, and the journal is never changed. All 69 tests pass (5 new).

**What it looks like** (just after "Why they slipped"):
```
Missed more than once (from missed.json and your journal):
  - insulin timing  [m1]: 2 times, last wrong Sep 25
```

**How it counts:**
- Each entry in `missed.json` counts as one miss of its topic.
- Each "wrong" result in the journal for that id counts as another miss. "right" and "studied" results don't count.
- If the same topic appears under several ids, those are added together, even if the capitals or spacing differ.
- Topics with the most misses come first.
- If no topic has been missed twice, the section doesn't appear. Your seed file has no repeats, so your normal plan looks exactly as before. In my 26 saved test commands, the only change is this section in the run that uses a journal.
- `--json` includes it as `missed_more_than_once`, with the topic, ids, count and last wrong date for each.
- It follows `--topic`.

**One thing to decide:** I counted journal "wrong" results as extra misses, on top of the original entry. If you'd rather it only group topics that appear more than once in `missed.json`, say so and I'll change it.

**Tests** (`tests/test_repeat_misses.py`):
- Wrong results add to the count, and "right", "studied", unknown ids and odd hand edits are ignored.
- The same topic under different ids is grouped.
- There's no section when nothing repeats.
- Text and JSON match.
- **Read-only check:** running the plan (text, `--json`, and `--topic`/`--days`) leaves the journal's contents and modified time unchanged, and creates no other files.

**The nursing review:** this is new wording in the plan, so I added it to the checklist in `REVIEW.md`. The review is still open and the draft notice is still on. I'm also still waiting on your answers about Dami's note and GitHub; nothing has been pushed or committed.
